When does New Year 2027 start in Singapore?

Singapore uses a single time zone on New Year's Eve, UTC+08:00, so the whole country welcomes 2027 at the same moment: midnight local time corresponds to 16:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

New Year's Day 2027 falls on a Friday.

Singapore in the global New Year countdown

The first places on Earth to enter 2027 are the Line Islands of Kiribati (UTC+14:00). Singapore follows 6 hours later, and the last inhabited places, American Samoa and Niue (UTC-11:00), celebrate 19 hours after Singapore.

When the clock strikes midnight in Singapore, 20 of the 196 countries in our world time zone table already have at least one region celebrating 2027.

  • Just before (UTC+09:00): Indonesia (Jayapura), Japan, Russia (Yakutsk), South Korea, East Timor, North Korea and Palau
  • Just after (UTC+07:00): Indonesia (Jakarta), Russia (Novosibirsk), Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Mongolia (Hovd) and Vietnam

Who celebrates at the same time as Singapore?

These countries also reach midnight at UTC+08:00, so they welcome 2027 at exactly the same moment as Singapore: Australia (Perth), China, Indonesia (Bali), Malaysia, Philippines, Russia (Irkutsk), Brunei, Mongolia (Ulaanbaatar) and Taiwan.

Frequently asked questions

What time is New Year 2027 in Singapore in UTC?

Midnight in Singapore corresponds to 16:00 UTC on Thursday, December 31, 2026.

How many time zones does Singapore have on New Year's Eve?

One. The whole country uses UTC+08:00 on New Year's Eve.

Is daylight saving time in effect in Singapore on New Year's Eve?

No. Singapore keeps UTC+08:00 all year round.

Which countries celebrate New Year just before Singapore?

The previous time zone to reach midnight is UTC+09:00, which includes Indonesia (Jayapura), Japan, Russia (Yakutsk), South Korea, East Timor, North Korea and Palau.
